messages:
maria: Heads-up — product asked for per-model adaptive quant profiles for embeddings to hit ~3x token cost reduction while keeping P95 < 120ms on Dedicated. Need rollout strategy + launch criteria. pinging eng-runtime, eng-infra, and product.

ken: Quick question — if our optimized quant kernels aren't available on some GPU types, what's the fallback? auto-fallback to fp16 and degrade throughput? Need to define behavior.

alia: FYI ran microbenchmarks yesterday. For ada-emb: int8 + kernel-A gives ~3x cost reduction at batch=8 and ~20% lower median latency, but P99 tail worsens for sequences > 512.

ben: :thumbsup: Product wants this fast. Suggest canary + rollback window. Also need trace tags to attribute errors to quant profile.

devbot: Deploy pipeline check: canary pipeline exists at deploys/canary/quant-profiles — see job ID #4532.

ken: Proposal sketch: 3-stage rollout — bench -> canary(1%) -> ramp(25%) -> GA. Launch criteria: bench passes perf regression and stability checks; canary P95 <120ms and error delta <0.5% vs baseline.

maria: Product also requests per-tenant opt-out for aggressive quant (enterprise customers). We'll need a config flag.

alia: Important: switching quant profiles can change KV cache layout. We need a migration or a strategy to invalidate/migrate caches without breaking in-flight sessions.

ben: Metrics we should add: tokens_served_quantized / tokens_total, latency_by_quant_profile, and cost_delta_by_model. Dashboards for both canary segments and overall.

product-ana: From product side — need a regression eval: 1000 prompt pairs with similarity score drop <1% for embeddings. Also a demo script for sales.

sre: Add alerting: rollout_monitoring should fire if P95 increases >20% sustained for 5m or error rate delta >0.5%. Also add burn rate checks for GPU utilization.

ken: Draft runtime config snippet: 
```
quant_profile:
  model: "ada-emb"
  mode: "adaptive"
  min_quality_drop: 0.01
  canary_pct: 1
  rollback_window_sec: 600
```

maria: Ownership: Eng-runtime = kernel selection + runtime flags; Eng-infra = canary pipeline + rollout ops; Product = evals, comms, and customer opt-out policy.

ken: I'll own runtime flags and kernel selection change. @sre can you own alerts and runbook? @ben can you own metrics + dashboards?

ben: On it — will add dashboards and a cost-delta heatmap; will also add an experiment tag to traces.

alia: I'll prototype a small migration tool for KV cache format changes. If migration is expensive we may opt for per-connection cache rebuild on profile switch.

maria: Good. Schedule a follow-up sync Wed 10:00 to finalize launch criteria + PR owners. Add details to shared doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/p/quant-rollout (put notes in the doc). :calendar:

devbot: Meeting created: Wed 10:00 — perf-quant-rollout-sync (invites sent).

ken: One more thought — we should include a cheap synthetic smoke test during canary that validates top-k similarity preserved for embeddings.

product-ana: Also confirm SLO implications for Dedicated customers before GA. We might need a special SLA clause for quantized runs.

maria: Agreed. We'll include SLA check in launch criteria. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
